We'll need some assistance once it's open, so check back soon.|Sprint, to a Jedi Knight|<ref name="Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)">[[Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures (video game)|''Star Wars: Clone Wars Adventures'']]</ref>}}
'''Sprint''' was a [[Clone cold assault trooper/Legends|clone snowtrooper]] serving in the [[Grand Army of the Republic/Legends|Grand Army of the Republic]] during the [[Clone Wars/Legends|Clone Wars]].

==Biography==
Cold assault trooper Sprint served in the [[Skirmish on Carlac]] along with a [[Unidentified Jedi Knight (Clone Wars)|Jedi General]], [[Clone Commander/Legends|Clone Commander]] [[Wolffe/Legends|Wolffe]], and other members of the [[104th Battalion/Legends|104th Battalion]]. He and a squad of troopers were stationed outside the wreckage of a crashed [[Munificent-class star frigate/Legends|''Munificent''-class star frigate]], attempting to find a way inside.
